environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind an Application Load Balancer with HTTPS listener on port 443. The ALB is configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) verification using a Trust Store associated with an internal PKI CA bundle (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/ts-internal-pki/abc123). The listener's MutualAuthentication mode is set to 'verify' (not 'passthrough'), meaning the ALB terminates connections that do not present a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA before forwarding to the Lambda target group. The Trust Store contains only certificates issued by the organization's internal Certificate Authority (CN=InternalOps-CA-G2, O=AcmeCorp) with a CRL distribution point actively checked. Client certificates are issued exclusively to internal service mesh sidecars and operator workstations enrolled via hardware security modules. The ALB access logs show the connection is rejected at the TLS handshake layer (no HTTP request is ever formed or forwarded to Lambda) when client cert validation fails.
